# RemoveGadgetItem

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
RemoveGadgetItem gadget:Int32, index:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | Int32 | required | Handle of a list box, combo box or tabber. |
| `index` | Int32 | required | Number of the entry, starting at 0. |

## Description

Takes one entry out of a list box, combo box or tabber. The entries after it move up by one.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Remove", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
list = CreateListBox(10, 10, 200, 100, win)
AddGadgetItem list, "Stays"
AddGadgetItem list, "Goes"
RemoveGadgetItem list, 1
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
